title: Packaging — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Packaging Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

gtin.title: GTIN
gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number assigned to the packaging unit.
gtin.x-citationNote: PPWR mandates no trade-item identifier anywhere. A GTIN is plausible content of the Art. 12 carrier dataset once the Art. 12(6) implementing act defines it, and is useful for linking to the packaged product's own carrier under the Art. 12(5) single-carrier rule, but nothing in force requires publishing it.

packagingType.title: Packaging Type
packagingType.description: Classification of packaging by function: sales, grouped, transport, e-commerce, or reusable.
packagingType.x-citationNote: It defines sales, grouped, transport, e-commerce and reusable packaging, but a definitions article imposes no duty to declare which one applies. The distinction does carry legal weight elsewhere — transport packaging is outside the Art. 12(1) label except for e-commerce — so the value is worth holding even though declaring it is not an obligation.

packagingFormat.title: Packaging Format
packagingFormat.description: Physical form of the packaging (bottle, box, bag, pouch, can, carton, tray, blister, wrapper, etc.).
packagingFormat.x-citationNote: No PPWR provision requires the physical form to be declared as data. It is plausible content of the Art. 12 carrier dataset once the implementing act defines one.

packagingWeight.title: Packaging Weight
packagingWeight.description: Total weight of the empty packaging in grams.
packagingWeight.x-citationNote: Empty-packaging weight is an input to the Art. 10 minimisation assessment rather than a declared datum. Art. 10 applies from 2030 and its calculation methodology comes by delegated act, so no in-force provision requires publishing this weight.

packagingVolume.title: Packaging Volume
packagingVolume.description: Total volume capacity of the packaging in millilitres.
packagingVolume.x-citationNote: No PPWR provision requires the volume to be declared. It is an input to the Art. 10 empty-space ratio, which applies from 2030 under a delegated calculation methodology.

isReusable.title: Is Reusable
isReusable.description: Whether the packaging is designed and intended for reuse.
isReusable.x-citationNote: It sets reuse criteria and targets from 2030. Reusability is a real regulatory characteristic — Art. 12(2) makes reusable packaging the one case where a data carrier is mandatory — but that duty is a label plus carrier for users, from 12 Feb 2029 or 30 months after the Art. 12(6) act, whichever is the latest. Declaring the flag as passport data is not itself an obligation.

isSingleUse.title: Is Single Use
isSingleUse.description: Whether the packaging is intended for single use only.
isSingleUse.x-citationNote: The complement of the Art. 11 reuse characteristic. No provision requires declaring it; its practical use is distinguishing packaging that falls outside the Art. 12(2) reusable label and carrier duty.

materialType.title: Material Type
materialType.description: Primary material of the packaging component.
materialType.x-citationNote: Material composition is the subject of the Art. 12(1) harmonised label, which is discharged by a PICTOGRAM on the packaging, not by publishing a data field. The identification methodology comes from the Art. 12(7) implementing act due 12 Aug 2026 and not yet adopted, and the label applies from 12 Aug 2028 or 24 months after that act, whichever is the latest.

weightPercent.title: Weight Percent
weightPercent.description: Percentage by weight of this material component relative to total packaging weight.
weightPercent.x-citationNote: Per-material weight share is an input to the Art. 6 recyclability and Art. 7 recycled-content assessments, both of which apply from 2030 under criteria set by delegated acts. No in-force provision requires declaring the share itself.

componentName.title: Component Name
componentName.description: Name of the packaging component (e.g. cap, body, label, sleeve).
componentName.x-citationNote: Component identification supports the separate-collection sorting information that Art. 12(1) allows on a voluntary QR code. Since that carrier is permissive and its dataset undefined, naming components is useful practice rather than a duty.

isContactSensitive.title: Is Contact Sensitive
isContactSensitive.description: Whether this material component is in direct contact with sensitive products (e.g. food, pharma).
isContactSensitive.x-citationNote: 'Contact-sensitive packaging' is a real Art. 7 category, because it carries different recycled-content targets. It is a scoping concept for that obligation, not a datum PPWR requires anyone to declare, and Art. 7 applies from 1 Jan 2030.

totalMaterialCount.title: Total Material Count
totalMaterialCount.description: Total number of distinct material types used in the packaging.
totalMaterialCount.x-citationNote: PPWR's technical documentation (Annex VII) holds the materials of components; no law requires a count. PPWR creates no passport.

isMultiMaterial.title: Is Multi-Material
isMultiMaterial.description: Whether the packaging consists of more than one material type.
isMultiMaterial.x-citationNote: Materials are recorded in the technical documentation (Annex VII); PPWR Art. 6 contains no multi-material datum. PPWR creates no passport.

materialPictogramCode.title: Material Pictogram Code
materialPictogramCode.description: Harmonized pictogram code for material identification, mandatory from August 2028.
materialPictogramCode.x-citationNote: The Art. 12(1) label is delivered as a pictogram, and its design comes from the Art. 12(6) implementing act due 12 Aug 2026 and not yet adopted. Until that act exists there is no harmonised code to carry.

performanceGrade.title: Recyclability Performance Grade
performanceGrade.description: Recyclability performance grade under PPWR Art. 6(3) and Annex II Table 3: A (>=95%), B (>=80%), C (>=70%). Below 70% is technically non-recyclable and may not be placed on the market from 2030 (or 24 months after the Art. 6(4) delegated acts, if later). Grade C is barred from 1 Jan 2038.
performanceGrade.x-citationNote: A/B/C; below 70% (non-recyclable) is barred from 2030 and C from 2038

recyclablePercent.title: Recyclable Percent
recyclablePercent.description: Percentage of the packaging that is recyclable by weight.
recyclablePercent.x-citationNote: Expresses recyclability as A-E design-for-recycling grades, not as a free percentage. A percent-recyclable figure is not the regulatory metric and no provision requires it; the grade it approximates depends on unadopted Art. 6(4) criteria and applies from 2030.

designForRecyclingCompliant.title: Design for Recycling Compliant
designForRecyclingCompliant.description: Whether the packaging meets design-for-recycling criteria per delegated acts.
designForRecyclingCompliant.x-citationNote: Design-for-recycling criteria are set by delegated acts under Art. 6(4), which are not adopted. Compliance is undeterminable until they exist, and the underlying obligation applies from 2030.

assessmentStandard.title: Assessment Standard
assessmentStandard.description: Standard or methodology used for recyclability assessment.
assessmentStandard.x-citationNote: Recyclability is assessed against design-for-recycling criteria set by delegated acts under Art. 6(4), which are not adopted. Naming the standard used records method rather than discharging an obligation.

atScaleRecycling.title: At-Scale Recycling
atScaleRecycling.description: Whether the packaging is recycled at scale (required from 2035).
atScaleRecycling.x-citationNote: It adds the 'recycled at scale' condition, which bites from 2035 and later than the design-for-recycling grades themselves. Both depend on criteria that delegated acts have yet to set, so neither is determinable today.

sortingEfficiency.title: Sorting Efficiency
sortingEfficiency.description: Percentage efficiency of sorting the packaging in waste management infrastructure.
sortingEfficiency.x-citationNote: Supports the Art. 6 recyclability assessment. The assessment methodology comes by delegated act under Art. 6(4) and applies from 2030; no provision in force requires publishing a sorting-efficiency figure.

recyclateQuality.title: Recyclate Quality
recyclateQuality.description: Quality assessment of the recyclate output from this packaging.
recyclateQuality.x-citationNote: Feeds the Art. 6 recyclability grading, whose criteria are not yet set. Recyclate quality is an input to that future assessment rather than a declared datum.

recycledContentMaterialType.title: Recycled Content Material Type
recycledContentMaterialType.description: Material type for which recycled content is declared.
recycledContentMaterialType.x-citationNote: It sets recycled-content minima per plastic material category, so the material dimension is real, but the obligation applies from 1 Jan 2030 and its calculation methodology comes by delegated act under Art. 7(8). Nothing in force requires declaring the category.

recycledPercent.title: Recycled Content Percent
recycledPercent.description: Total percentage of recycled content in the material by weight.
recycledPercent.x-citationNote: It sets minimum recycled content for plastic packaging from 1 Jan 2030, with the calculation and verification methodology to be set by delegated act under Art. 7(8). Where a share of recycled content IS voluntarily labelled, Art. 12(4) requires that label to follow the Art. 7(8) methodology — a conditional format rule, not a duty to declare.

postConsumerPercent.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Percent
postConsumerPercent.description: Percentage of post-consumer recycled content in the material.
postConsumerPercent.x-citationNote: Only post-consumer recyclate counts toward the Art. 7 targets, so this is the operative metric of that obligation — but the obligation applies from 2030 through a delegated methodology that does not yet exist.

preConsumerPercent.title: Pre-Consumer Recycled Percent
preConsumerPercent.x-citationNote: Counts only POST-consumer recyclate toward its targets, so a pre-consumer share does not contribute to the obligation at all. The targets themselves apply from 1 Jan 2030 under a delegated methodology.

certificationScheme.title: Certification Scheme
certificationScheme.description: Third-party certification scheme verifying recycled content claims.
certificationScheme.x-citationNote: It requires the Commission to set the calculation, verification and reporting methodology for recycled content by delegated act. That act is not adopted, so no certification scheme is prescribed and none can be mandated.

massBalanceApplied.title: Mass Balance Applied
massBalanceApplied.description: Whether mass balance accounting was used for recycled content calculation.
massBalanceApplied.x-citationNote: Whether mass balance may be used to attribute recycled content is exactly the question the Art. 7(8) methodology delegated act will settle. Until it does, the attribution rule does not exist to be declared against.

binDestination.title: Bin Destination
binDestination.description: Which waste bin or stream this component should be disposed in.
binDestination.x-citationNote: Waste-stream destination is the substance of the Art. 12(1) harmonised sorting label, delivered as a pictogram whose format the Art. 12(6) implementing act will set. The duty is to mark the packaging, not to publish the destination as data.

pictogramUrl.title: Sorting Pictogram URL
pictogramUrl.description: URL to the harmonized sorting/disposal pictogram image for this component.
pictogramUrl.x-citationNote: The Art. 12(1) harmonised pictogram is defined by the Art. 12(6) implementing act, due 12 Aug 2026 and unadopted. The duty when it arrives is to MARK the packaging; hosting an image supports that rather than replacing it.

consumerInstruction.title: Consumer Instruction
consumerInstruction.description: Instructions for the consumer on how to sort/dispose of this component.
consumerInstruction.x-citationNote: Consumer sorting and disposal guidance is Art. 12(1) harmonised-label content, set by the Art. 12(6) implementing act due 12 Aug 2026 and not yet adopted. Art. 12(5) also requires that information to be available before purchase in online sales, which a passport can satisfy — but the obligation itself is not in force.

localizedLanguage.title: Localized Language
localizedLanguage.description: Language code for the localized sorting/disposal instructions.
localizedLanguage.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

depositReturnSystemApplicable.title: Deposit Return System Applicable
depositReturnSystemApplicable.description: Whether this packaging is subject to a deposit-return scheme (DRS).
depositReturnSystemApplicable.x-citationNote: It requires Member States to establish deposit-and-return systems for single-use plastic bottles and metal cans by 1 Jan 2029. In-scope packaging must bear a clear national DRS label under Art. 12(1); the applicability flag supports that marking rather than being separately mandated. Note DRS packaging is excluded from the Art. 12(1) material-composition label.

depositReturnSystemId.title: Deposit Return System ID
depositReturnSystemId.description: Identifier of the deposit-return system this packaging is registered with.
depositReturnSystemId.x-citationNote: It requires Member States to establish deposit-and-return systems by 1 Jan 2029, and Art. 12(1) requires in-scope packaging to bear a clear national DRS label. The system is identified by that national marking, not by a scheme identifier in a passport.

minRotations.title: Minimum Rotations
minRotations.description: Minimum number of reuse rotations/trips the packaging is designed for.
minRotations.x-citationNote: It is a DEFINITIONAL test — packaging 'shall be considered to be reusable where' it meets criteria including being designed for as many rotations as possible. Meeting the criteria confers the status; the Regulation sets no minimum rotation count to declare, and rotation targets sit in the Art. 11 regime from 2030.

reuseSystemName.title: Reuse System Name
reuseSystemName.description: Name of the reuse system or scheme the packaging participates in.
reuseSystemName.x-citationNote: It governs reuse systems and Annex VI distinguishes open and closed loops with and without a system operator. Naming the system is operationally useful; the Art. 12(2) carrier duty for reusable packaging is what the Regulation actually requires, from 12 Feb 2029 or 30 months after the implementing act, whichever is the latest.

collectionPointsUrl.title: Collection Points URL
collectionPointsUrl.description: URL to a page listing collection/return points for reusable packaging.
collectionPointsUrl.x-citationNote: Art. 12(2) requires information on reusability — including the availability of a re-use system and collection points — to be made available through a QR code or other digital carrier. That is the one mandatory carrier in PPWR, and this is genuinely its content, but it applies from 12 Feb 2029 or 30 months after the Art. 12(6) act, whichever is the latest, and only to reusable packaging.

reuseInstructions.title: Reuse Instructions
reuseInstructions.description: Instructions for the consumer on how to return or reuse the packaging.
reuseInstructions.x-citationNote: Art. 12(2) makes reuse information carrier content for REUSABLE packaging from 12 Feb 2029 or 30 months after the Art. 12(6) implementing act, whichever is the latest. Open-loop systems without a system operator are exempt under Art. 12(3).

substanceName.title: Substance Name
substanceName.description: Name of the substance of concern present in the packaging.
substanceName.x-citationNote: Art. 5(1) requires substances of concern to be MINIMISED, not itemised. The disclosure route is Art. 12(1) second subparagraph: such packaging must be marked using digital marking technologies per the Art. 12(7) methodology, which is due by 1 Jan 2030 and must carry at least the name and concentration per material per packaging unit. Separately, SVHCs above 0.1% w/w are notified to ECHA's SCIP database under the Waste Framework Directive — neither duty is discharged by publishing here.

casNumber.title: CAS Number
casNumber.description: Chemical Abstracts Service registry number for the substance.
casNumber.x-citationNote: It requires substances of concern in packaging to be MINIMISED, not itemised. The disclosure route is the Art. 12(1) digital marking of such packaging, whose methodology is due by 1 Jan 2030 under Art. 12(7) and must then carry the substance name and concentration per material per unit. A CAS number is not itself mandated.

concentrationPpm.title: Concentration (ppm)
concentrationPpm.description: Concentration of the substance in the packaging material in parts per million.
concentrationPpm.x-citationNote: Concentration becomes a marking element only through the Art. 12(7) substances methodology due by 1 Jan 2030, which requires name and concentration per material in a packaging unit. Until then Art. 5(1) is a minimisation duty with no per-substance disclosure list, so a product-level concentration is voluntary and its eventual shape provisional.

maxAllowedPpm.title: Maximum Allowed (ppm)
maxAllowedPpm.x-citationNote: Art. 5(4) caps the SUM of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium at 100 mg/kg in packaging or packaging components. It is a restriction on placing packaging on the market — stay under it and hold the evidence — not a duty to publish the limit or the measured value.

pfasPresent.title: PFAS Present
pfasPresent.description: Whether per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are present in the packaging.
pfasPresent.x-citationNote: PPWR Art. 5(5) sets PFAS limits for food-contact packaging, shown in the technical documentation; it is a limit, not a presence flag. PPWR creates no passport.

heavyMetalsSumPpm.title: Heavy Metals Sum (ppm)
heavyMetalsSumPpm.description: Sum of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium concentrations. Must be <= 100 ppm.
heavyMetalsSumPpm.x-citationNote: PPWR Art. 5(4) caps the sum of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium at 100 mg/kg, shown in the technical documentation. PPWR creates no passport.

heavyMetalsMaxPpm.title: Heavy Metals Maximum Allowed (ppm)
heavyMetalsMaxPpm.description: Regulatory maximum for the sum of Pb + Cd + Hg + Cr(VI). Currently 100 ppm.
heavyMetalsMaxPpm.x-citationNote: The Art. 5(4) restriction is a 100 mg/kg cap on the combined concentration of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium, not a per-metal disclosure. Compliance is demonstrated through the technical documentation behind the Art. 15 declaration of conformity.

labelHarmonized.title: Harmonized Label Applied
labelHarmonized.description: Whether the packaging bears the EU harmonized labelling per PPWR Art. 12.
labelHarmonized.x-citationNote: The Art. 12(1) harmonised label becomes mandatory from 12 Aug 2028 or 24 months after the Art. 12(6)/(7) implementing acts, whichever is the latest. Those acts are due 12 Aug 2026 and unadopted, so the date is not yet fixed and a 'label applied' flag records readiness rather than compliance with anything in force.

materialCompositionPictogram.title: Material Composition Pictogram
materialCompositionPictogram.description: URL or reference to the material composition pictogram on the packaging.
materialCompositionPictogram.x-citationNote: The Art. 12(1) material-composition label is a pictogram whose design and the identification methodology behind it come from the Art. 12(6) and 12(7) implementing acts, both due 12 Aug 2026 and neither adopted. The duty is to mark the packaging.

bioBasedContentPercent.title: Bio-Based Content Percent
bioBasedContentPercent.description: Voluntary declaration of bio-based content percentage in the packaging material.
bioBasedContentPercent.x-citationNote: Art. 12(4) makes bio-based plastic content a CONDITIONAL labelling rule: where packaging is voluntarily marked with such a claim, the label must follow the specifications in the Art. 12(6) implementing act. Nothing requires making the claim, and no in-force provision mandates declaring the percentage.

compostabilityCertified.title: Compostability Certified
compostabilityCertified.description: Whether the packaging has been certified as compostable.
compostabilityCertified.x-citationNote: It governs compostable packaging, and Art. 12(1) requires the label of packaging covered by Art. 9(1) to indicate that the material is compostable, not suitable for home composting, and not to be discarded in nature. The duty lands on that label rather than on a certification flag in a passport.

compostabilityStandard.title: Compostability Standard
compostabilityStandard.description: Standard under which compostability was certified (e.g. EN 13432).
compostabilityStandard.x-citationNote: Compostability is assessed against harmonised standards supporting Art. 8; naming the standard records method. What the Regulation requires is the Art. 12(1) label statement for packaging within the Art. 9(1) scope.

declarationId.title: Declaration of Conformity ID
declarationId.description: Unique identifier of the EU declaration of conformity for this packaging.
declarationId.x-citationNote: It requires an EU declaration of conformity to be drawn up, and that is the obligation — a document held by the manufacturer, not published data. The standard EU DoC model requires no unique identifier, so this subfield is a convenience for referencing it.

issuerName.title: Issuer Name
issuerName.description: Name of the entity that issued the declaration of conformity.
issuerName.x-citationNote: Content of the EU declaration of conformity (Art. 39, Annex VIII), not passport data; PPWR creates no passport.

issueDate.title: Issue Date
issueDate.description: Date when the declaration of conformity was issued.
issueDate.x-citationNote: The EU declaration of conformity carries its place and date of issue (Annex VIII). PPWR creates no passport.

conformsToArticles.title: Conforms to Articles
conformsToArticles.description: List of PPWR articles/provisions the packaging conforms to.
conformsToArticles.x-citationNote: The declaration of conformity's statement is fixed at Arts. 5 to 12 (Art. 39(1)). PPWR creates no passport.

documentUrl.title: Declaration Document URL
documentUrl.description: URL to the full declaration of conformity document.
documentUrl.x-citationNote: It requires the EU declaration of conformity to be DRAWN UP and kept, with the technical documentation, at the disposal of market surveillance authorities. It is a held document; publishing a link is voluntary transparency.

dataCarrierType.title: Data Carrier Type
dataCarrierType.description: Type of data carrier on the packaging (QR code per PPWR).
dataCarrierType.x-citationNote: Art. 12 mandates no carrier for general packaging: the Art. 12(1) sorting QR is permissive and the material-composition duty is a pictogram. Only Art. 12(2) reusable packaging must carry one, from 12 Feb 2029 or 30 months after the Art. 12(6) act, whichever is the latest. The carrier's technical specification comes from that same unadopted act.

dataCarrierUri.title: Data Carrier URI
dataCarrierUri.description: GS1 Digital Link URI encoded in the data carrier.
dataCarrierUri.x-citationNote: The URI encoded in a packaging carrier is content of a dataset the Art. 12(6) implementing act has not yet defined. Where the packaged product carries its own carrier under other Union law, Art. 12(5) requires a SINGLE carrier serving both, with the two easily distinguishable — so this value cannot be designed in isolation from the product's.

dataCarrierFormat.title: Data Carrier Format
dataCarrierFormat.description: Technical format specification of the data carrier.
dataCarrierFormat.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

dataCarrierEncoding.title: Data Carrier Encoding
dataCarrierEncoding.description: Character encoding used in the data carrier.
dataCarrierEncoding.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

retentionPeriodYears.title: Data Retention Period (Years)
retentionPeriodYears.description: Number of years the DPP data must be retained. 5 for single-use, 10 for reusable packaging.
retentionPeriodYears.x-citationNote: A record-keeping duty (5 years single-use, 10 years reusable), not disclosed data. PPWR creates no passport.

accessTier.title: Access Tier
accessTier.description: Default data access tier for the data carrier content.
accessTier.x-citationNote: Voluntary today. ESPR Art. 10(1)(g) governs access to passport data, but only for a passport mandated under Art. 9(1) via an Art. 4 delegated act — none is adopted for packaging, which PPWR governs without creating a passport.

emptySpacePercent.title: Empty Space Percent
emptySpacePercent.description: Percentage of empty space in the packaging relative to total volume.
emptySpacePercent.x-citationNote: It caps the empty-space ratio at 50% for grouped, transport and e-commerce packaging from 2030, with the calculation methodology to be set by delegated act. The ratio is the operative metric of that future obligation, not a datum required today.

maxAllowedEmptySpacePercent.title: Maximum Allowed Empty Space Percent
maxAllowedEmptySpacePercent.description: Maximum empty space ratio for grouped, transport and e-commerce packaging: 50% under PPWR Art. 24(1), applying from 1 Jan 2030 or 3 years after the Art. 24(2) implementing act, whichever is later. The duty falls on the operator who fills the packaging.
maxAllowedEmptySpacePercent.x-citationNote: Art. 24(1) caps the void space at 50% for grouped, transport and e-commerce packaging from 1 Jan 2030 (or 3 years after Art. 24(2) implementing act); the methodology comes by implementing act. The cap is a design limit, not a value to declare.

weightOptimised.title: Weight Optimised
weightOptimised.description: Whether the packaging weight has been optimised to the minimum necessary for safety and hygiene.
weightOptimised.x-citationNote: It requires packaging to be minimised to the weight and volume necessary for functionality, safety and hygiene, assessed against the Annex IV criteria from 2030. The duty is to design to that limit and hold the assessment, not to publish an optimisation flag.
